input.description: See features.py: piece planes of the last history_length positions (newest first, zero planes before the start of the game), the player plane (0 attackers, 1 defenders), then the optional constant, reach and defender-region planes. All values are 0 or 1.

policy.index: from_square * 4 * (N-1) + direction * (N-1) + (distance - 1), with from_square = row * N + col and directions 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right
policy.note: logits; take the softmax over the legal moves only

value: tanh output in [-1, 1] for the player to move

ending.note: logits of how the game will end; take the softmax over the endings the rules allow (exit_fort and encircled only where those rules are on)

moves_left: the expected number of plies until the game ends
network_description: 6x48 res, dense policy, dense value, 4 planes, 691,488 parameters

rules.name: sami_tablut
rules.description: Sami Tablut 9x9 as in the WTF championship (Saami Tablut-w, defenders first)

run_name: sami_tablut baseline: 6x48 plain blocks, dense heads (the old train_tablut.py defaults)
